description: Composition of simultaneous term substitutions is associative.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose_assoc.{u, v, w, w', w'', u_1} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} {β : Type w'} {γ : Type w''} {δ : Type u_1} (υ : γ → L.Term δ) (τ : β → L.Term γ) (σ : α → L.Term β) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose υ (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose τ σ) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.compose υ τ) σ
